overview.title: About Nous Research
paragraphs: Nous Research publishes the Hermes Agent project under its official GitHub organization. The project provides a useful window into the team’s agent-system work: it combines an interactive agent with mechanisms for carrying context and task knowledge between sessions.

Hermes documents memory, Skills, tool integrations, and scheduling as related but distinct capabilities. That distinction matters when studying ongoing work: remembering a preference, keeping a conversation, and saving a reusable procedure do not solve the same problem.

The representative repository uses MIT, while model access and connected services have their own conditions. A system that stores procedural knowledge also needs review and correction over time; the organization’s authorship does not make every saved task method universally reliable.

faq.question: Which project represents Nous Research here?
faq.answer: Hermes Agent is the selected public project. Its source and documentation connect the publisher to a system combining memory, procedural Skills, tools, and scheduled tasks.

faq.question: Is Hermes only a set of reusable instructions?
faq.answer: No. Instructions are part of a larger running agent application. The surrounding system manages interaction, context, tool connections, and continuing work.

faq.question: Why separate memory from procedural Skills?
faq.answer: Memory can preserve useful facts or preferences, while a Skill describes how to approach a task. They require different review questions and should not be treated as interchangeable storage.

faq.question: Does the project provide universal service access?
faq.answer: No. Tool connections and model providers require their own setup and authorization. The existence of an integration does not establish account entitlement or permission to use every connected system.

faq.question: Who is responsible for reviewing learned routines?
faq.answer: The person or team operating the system should review procedures against their task, source, and current environment. Saved instructions can become stale even when the application remains maintained.

faq.question: Does Hermes use the same terms as Nous model projects?
faq.answer: Do not assume so. Hermes Agent’s source is MIT licensed; each model artifact or hosted service needs its own license and access review.

faq.answer: 应检查工作流匹配度、模型服务配置、执行环境、数据处理文档与项目声明。公开源码有助于研究，但不能代替对所选配置的具体评估。

zh.ctaTitle: 借鉴 ZCode 的工作流设计
zh.ctaDescription: 从项目介绍中找到值得复用的机制，为自己的工作流规划一个可验证的小型改进。
